grades: Finished grade 10 or 11 (rising juniors and seniors)
name: UH Manoa Summer Scholar Program
org: University of Hawaii at Manoa Outreach College
what_you_do: High school students take UH Manoa summer classes. They learn with college students. They earn college credit.
who_can_apply: Students who will have finished their sophomore or junior year. You need a 3.5 GPA, the maturity for college work and approval from a parent or guardian.
pay_detail: Student pays tuition, fees and materials at UH Manoa resident undergraduate rates. A $1,200 need-based scholarship is available to Hawaii students who get free or reduced-price meals or school financial aid (first come, first served).
duration: Courses in sessions: May 26 to July 2, July 6 to Aug 14, or June 15 to July 24 (2026 dates)
deadline_text: The 2026 application deadline was April 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply to the Summer Scholar Program. Once you are in, sign up for UH Manoa summer classes. Contact sscholar@hawaii.edu or 808-956-9246.
notes: No on-campus housing. Courses can be cancelled for low enrollment.
